reports.title: Tencent Music Entertainment Group Announces Third Quarter 2026 Unaudited Financial Results

desk.headline: Revenue up 5.6% to RMB8.94bn, below estimates; adjusted EPS per ADS flat at RMB1.55; no formal guidance

numbers.eps_basis: non-IFRS diluted per ADS (RMB; about US$0.23); IFRS diluted RMB1.36 vs RMB1.38

results: Revenue rose 5.6% to RMB8.94bn (US$1.33bn), short of the RMB9.14bn estimate; adjusted EPS per ADS was RMB1.55 vs RMB1.54.
Music services grew 10.2%, helped by consolidating audio platform Ximalaya, Super VIP growth, concerts and artist merchandise; the older social-entertainment business shrank 15.7%.
Gross margin eased to 42.8% from 43.5% as lower-margin merchandise and live shows grew, and operating costs rose 16.9% with the Ximalaya deal.
IFRS net profit attributable to shareholders was flat at RMB2.15bn; adjusted EBITDA rose 2.7% to RMB3.02bn.
Cash and investments rose to RMB51.49bn after a US$1bn bond issue; the company bought back US$300m of ADSs in the quarter.

guidance.summary: Tencent Music does not give numeric guidance. On the call, management said it expects second-half revenue growth to beat its earlier expectations and momentum to carry into 2027, but gave no figures.

points: Super VIP grew in both paying users and spend per user, with better retention; long-form audio is now a key selling point for the top tier.
Q3 was Ximalaya's first full quarter in the group; management believes the toughest competition there is behind it and expects steady growth in 2027.
Concerts and merchandise should grow faster in Q4; these carry lower margins, so group margin may move around but stay 'in a healthy range'.
Advertising remains under pressure from the economy and tighter advertiser budgets; competition in streaming and live events was described as intense.
Management expects to complete its buyback programme on schedule.
call.source: Call coverage: Investing.com call transcript, 17 Nov 2026

watch: Whether IP businesses (concerts, merchandise) lift Q4 growth as promised, and the effect on gross margin.
Ximalaya's growth and profit contribution in 2027.
Advertising trends and continued decline in social entertainment.
